name: Kojima Junna
source:
[A loose-lipped, show-off gyaru full of attitude]

With her bright personality and unrivaled athletic ability, she is the mood-maker of the team. 
She is also fashionable and is knowledgeable about the latest fashion trends.

However, she is so showy that she tries to make herself look bigger, which leads to her lying, which is found amusing by the twins sisters and others.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara05.html]official site[/url]]
